contents:
Upcoming

{DATE} at {TIME} - dentist cleaning
Tuesday at 6:00 PM - dinner with Carol
Friday morning - call the plumber
Saturday - library book sale

Calendar reminders

{DATE} - oil change
{TIME} - pick up prescription
Next Thursday - lunch with Sam
First Monday next month - neighborhood meeting

Milk
Eggs
Coffee
Dish soap
Apples
Cat food
Light bulbs
Birthday card for Linda

Check whether we still need paper towels.

Grocery list

- bread
- cheddar cheese
- tomatoes
- bananas
- laundry detergent
- tea
- frozen peas

Use the coupon for coffee.

Garden plan

Tomatoes along the south fence. Basil between them. Move the hostas away from the sunny corner. Ask Ray if he still has extra marigold seeds.

Plants that survived last year

Lavender - did well
Rosemary - bring inside before frost
Tomatoes - needed more water
Zucchini - far too many

Try snap peas this spring.

House jobs

[ ] tighten kitchen cabinet handle
[ ] replace porch bulb
[ ] measure guest-room window
[ ] clean dryer vent
[ ] find matching paint for hallway

Weekend repair list

The bathroom faucet still drips. Garage shelf needs another bracket. Weather stripping is loose by the back door. Take photos before going to the hardware store.

Books to read

The Thursday Murder Club
A Gentleman in Moscow
The Secret Garden (reread)
The library's new local-history book

Ask June what the mystery with the lighthouse was called.

Book club possibilities

Something funny this time. No books over 500 pages. Ruth suggested a travel memoir and Carol wants another mystery. Decide by {DATE}.

Possible fall trip

Drive instead of fly. Find a place near hiking but not too remote. Check museum hours. Bring the good camera and the blue raincoat.

Places we talked about

- the lake cabins
- train trip through the mountains
- three days in the old coastal town

Need somewhere with easy walking and a decent breakfast.

People to call

Carol - confirm Sunday dinner
Dr. Lee's office - move appointment
Ray - return ladder
Insurance office - ask about the new form

Phone notes

The pharmacy said the refill will be ready after {TIME}. Call the vet tomorrow morning. Ask Ellen whether she wants the extra concert ticket.

Computer questions

Why does the printer say offline?
Move family photos to the new folder.
Make the text bigger in the email program.
Ask Peter how to stop the weather popups.

Things the computer keeps doing

Printer disappears after restart. The recipe website opens too many advertisements. Camera light did not turn on during last video call.

Milo's schedule

Breakfast at 7
Short walk after breakfast
One scoop for dinner at 5
Evening walk before dark

He will pretend he has not eaten. Do not believe him.

Pet sitter notes

Food is in the pantry. Fresh water every morning. The back gate sticks, so pull it toward you before latching it. Emergency treats are on top of the refrigerator.
